```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source(here::here("R/publication_artifacts.R"))
begin_artifact_render("clin_effect_figure_s1")
source(here::here("R/report_setup.R"))
setup_report(
  funs = c("dag_helpers"),
  packages = c("here", "ggplot2", "dplyr", "dagitty", "ggdag"),
  set_theme = FALSE
)
```

```{r dag-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=7}
#| fig-cap: "Causal DAG for the METIMMOX-1 analysis. Node colour indicates role: blue = exposure (T), red = outcomes (PFS, OS), green = latent variable (U), grey = covariates and intermediate variables. Solid arrows denote assumed causal effects; dashed arrows indicate the hypothesised interaction effects of T x TMB/BRAF and T x CRP on PFS and OS. Node abbreviations: T = Treatment; TxTMB = Treatment x TMB/BRAF interaction; TxCRP = Treatment x CRP interaction; TLR = Tumour Lesion Reduction; U = Unmeasured confounders."

p <- plot_full_dag(dag)
print(p)
```

```{r save-figure, include=FALSE}
figs_dir <- here("outputs", "figs")
if (!dir.exists(figs_dir)) dir.create(figs_dir, recursive = TRUE)

save_artifact_plot(
  filename = here("outputs", "figs", "clin_effect_figure_s1.png"),
  plot = p,
  width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
)
cat("Figure saved to:", here("outputs", "figs", "clin_effect_figure_s1.png"), "\n")
```

Figure saved to `outputs/figs/clin_effect_figure_s1.png`.

```{r artifact-manifest, include=FALSE}
finish_artifact_render()
```
